key_events: Rhea retrieved her Scrap Parchment and Charcoal Stick to draft a formal grievance.
Unit 734 projected the bureaucratic syntax for Form 88-B.
Rhea formatted the grievance, citing the node's undocumented maintenance allocation.
Rhea invoked the Evidentiary Sequestration clause to use the Soul-Bound Liability as proof without transferring it.
The system verified the syntax, awaiting final execution.
Rhea executed the final submission command for the grievance.
The local node identified the undocumented maintenance allocation.
An automated asset freeze was triggered, locking down the Maintenance Trenches.
The environment shifted into an active audit state.
The maintenance trenches began actively locking down.
Rhea stowed the Scrap Parchment and Charcoal Stick to keep her hands free.
Vance equipped the Rebar and used it to smash through a descending security gate.
The party dodged a localized deletion sweep.
They navigated the collapsing access shaft to escape the quarantine bulkheads.
The party burst from the collapsing access shaft onto the Outpost Surface.
The sky glitched into a violent purple as the System began processing the 14.3% withheld value.
XP and loot rained down as dangerous physical objects, cratering the surface.
Vance blocked a crystallized XP shard with his Rebar, taking concussive damage that dropped his HP to 2.
The party was trapped under the crushing physical weight of the unallocated rewards.
The 14.3% withheld value rained down on the Outpost Surface as dangerous physical objects.
Rhea and Vance rapidly leveled up and allocated stat points to survive the crushing mass.
Rhea increased her Strength and Vitality, raising her encumbrance limit.
Vance's HP increased to 15/150 after leveling up.
Both characters purchased additional system inventory slots to stow the physical loot.
The party stabilized their immediate survival, but the storm continued.
The physical refund storm subsided, leaving the party in a crater.
Rhea confirmed her Level 7 stats and expanded Encumbrance Limit.
Vance survived the concussive impacts with 15 HP.
The party realized they had painted a massive target on their backs for the local overseer.
The automated system freeze was broken by a manual override from the local overseer.
The environment experienced a complete physical freeze, suspending gravity and sound.
Unit 734's chassis was hijacked to act as a projection node.
The overseer projected a towering, furious avatar into the crater.
Rhea was explicitly targeted by the overseer as the source of the audit.
The Overseer bypassed standard dialogue to directly interrogate Rhea.
Rhea confirmed that the Raw Data Packet was protected by the Soul-Bound Liability contract.
The Overseer initiated an Administrative Disciplinary Action, applying the Audit Compliance (Red-Tier) warning.
The Hostile Environment Marker disabled passive regeneration and increased environmental hazards by 300%.
The projection collapsed, leaving Unit 734 smoking and the party facing a mathematically lethal environment.
